title: Hall confirms tall white restroom visits at the Nellis weather station
place_text: Base operations building, Nellis AFB, Nevada

tellings.quote: Now I know from firsthand experience that he was telling the truth because there came a day when I had work

plain: Charles Hall, who says he spent three years among tall, pale beings he calls the Tall Whites near Area 51, says that in 1965 he confirmed for himself that these beings used the restroom in the base operations building at Nellis Air Force Base in Nevada, where the weather station was. Someone had told him so, and Hall tells Michels he knows "from firsthand experience that he was telling the truth" because a day came when his own work took him there, which, if true, would put the beings inside an ordinary base building.
